name: Haishinsha no Chouten ni Ore wa Tatsu! - Subete o Ubae! Mezase 100 Man Shasei!!
original_name: 配信者の頂点に俺はタツ！　すべてを奪え！目指せ100万射精!！
source:
The protagonist, Tojou Renta, made his living as a Let’s Player. He would come home late at night, record footage, edit the video himself, and upload it, yet the view counts never amounted to much, and he was starting to feel both impatience and his own limits.

One day, just after he’d finished recording and was uploading the video to his channel, he happened to notice a thumbnail for the popular streamer group "Team Revo". Emblazoned across it were the words: "AUDITIONS OPEN FOR NEW MEMBER!"

Curious, he clicked the accompanying video. There, every major name currently dominating the streaming scene appeared on-screen together, explaining that they were officially scouting a new teammate. For a moment Renta hesitated, pride and the weight of his own middling career flashing through his mind — but the desire to be acknowledged won out, and he applied on the spot.

A miracle happened: he sailed through the document screening, aced the face-to-face interview, and before he knew it was told:
"Congratulations, you’re in. Come to the office tomorrow."

His heart pounded at the thought of finally belonging to a top-tier team. From tomorrow on he’d be working side-by-side with the industry’s elite! There was no way his future couldn’t be bright..!

At least, that’s what he believed... back on that day, before they asked him to do "that".

[Translated from the [url=https://binbin1919.com/STUB/002/index.html]official site[/url]]
